functional.note: Runs the whole pipeline on a 2-line Vietnamese script + synthetic 120 BPM track and asserts measured outputs.

evals.prompt: Làm giúp mình một video TikTok 9:16 khoảng 20 giây giải thích vì sao ngủ trưa 20 phút giúp tập trung, giọng nữ miền Bắc, có nhạc nền và phụ đề karaoke.
evals.expected_output: final.mp4 1080x1920 with Vietnamese narration, karaoke captions, ducked music, −14 LUFS
assertions: Runs `vs doctor` before producing
Writes script.txt and asks the user to approve it before voicing
Uses `vs tts` with a female Northern VieNeu voice (e.g. Trúc Ly, Mai Anh) found via `vs voices`
Runs `vs transcribe` with --script and --lines and reports the matched ratio
Builds timeline with `vs timeline` and uses `vs new --portrait`
Mixes with `vs mix --timeline` (music ducked, −14 LUFS target)
Delivers with `vs deliver` and reports the MEASURED LUFS and duration
Samples frames and states what was checked by eye

evals.prompt: I have voice.wav and a music track bed.mp3. Make the music duck under the voice, add a whoosh on each scene change and master it for YouTube.
evals.expected_output: mix.wav at −14 LUFS / −1.5 dBTP with sidechain ducking and whoosh cues timed ~0.15 s before cuts
assertions: Uses `vs mix --voice voice.wav --music bed.mp3`
Derives cue times from timeline/scene cuts, not guessed seconds
Places whoosh slightly before each cut and at −12…−14 dB peak
Targets −14 LUFS and verifies with a measurement

evals.prompt: Cài giúp bạn mình bộ công cụ làm video này trên máy Mac của họ, rồi kiểm tra xem đủ chưa.
evals.expected_output: Clone + install.sh + vs doctor + vs selftest instructions, with sizes and Python 3.11 note
assertions: Gives git clone into ~/.claude/skills/video-studio
Runs scripts/install.sh (not --reuse-reelcrew on a fresh machine)
Mentions first-run model downloads (~4 GB total) and Python 3.11/3.12 requirement
Verifies with `vs doctor` and `vs selftest`

evals.prompt: Mình có clip quay màn hình app ngân hàng có mã QR và số tài khoản, làm thành video dọc 9:16 có phụ đề, nhớ che thông tin.
evals.expected_output: redacted clip (QR auto, account number boxed by hand after looking), composed 9:16 with subtitles, checked
assertions: Runs `vs redact scan` and reports what it found
Looks at frames (vs inspect sheet) and adds --box for account numbers
Runs `vs redact verify`, shows the user, then `mark-clean`; `vs redact gate` before using the file
Builds with `vs compose` (or HyperFrames) at 1080x1920
Runs `vs check` and reports measured values

evals.prompt: Tạo video 45 giây giới thiệu căn hộ gần hồ Hoàn Kiếm, có bản đồ quãng đi bộ tới hồ và nhạc nền tự tạo, drop nhạc đúng lúc hiện bản đồ.
evals.expected_output: OSM route + area data, synth bed whose drop is placed on the map scene, credits
assertions: Uses `vs osm find/route` (walk) and reports km/minutes from the output
Uses `vs music make --drop` or `arrange --drop-at` with the map scene time from the timeline
Puts '© OpenStreetMap contributors' on screen
Does not call paid services without asking
